topic: Nano Banana Pro English model-page rewrite

releaseThesis.thesis: Nano Banana Pro is a free, no-sign-up AI image generator for prompt-led creation and reference-guided image editing with up to eight uploaded reference images and 1K, 2K, or 4K output choices.

previousVersionBaseline.reason: No reliable official previous-version baseline was used for this rewrite.

primaryDelta.reason: The page uses non-comparative positioning rather than an unverified upgrade claim.

userProblemsSolved: Lets creators start from a written brief or combine several visual references in one image workflow.
Keeps output size, format, and common publishing ratios in the same generation flow.
bestFor: Reference-guided image editing with up to eight uploaded images
Image creation that needs 1K, 2K, or 4K output choices
chooseAlternativeWhen: Choose Nano Banana 2 when a project needs more than eight references or its extra ultra-wide and ultra-tall ratios.

officialSources.claim: Nano Banana Pro is a Google DeepMind image generation and editing model with improved text rendering, enhanced world knowledge, multiple-language text generation, reference consistency, diagrams/infographics support, and up to 4K resolution.
Toolaze-supported settings include text-to-image and image-to-image, up to eight reference images, 1K/2K/4K output choices, supported ratios, and PNG/JPEG/WebP output choices.

officialFeatureEvidence.userOutcome: Evaluate type hierarchy, language treatment, and layout in posters, mockups, packaging concepts, and social creative.

officialFeatureEvidence.officialCapability: Google describes consistency by design, including maintaining the consistency and resemblance of people and supplied elements in complex compositions.
officialFeatureEvidence.userOutcome: Keep a recognizable subject or visual identity while changing scene, styling, lighting, or composition.

officialFeatureEvidence.officialCapability: Google describes reasoning and world knowledge for diagrams, infographics, and context-rich visuals, plus available 2K and 4K resolution. Toolaze supports up to eight references and 1K/2K/4K choices.
officialFeatureEvidence.userOutcome: Turn an information-heavy brief into a visual explanation or a product composition that connects several supplied directions.
